concerns.text: US-2 scenario 1 requires 'the feature importance ranking of the top 10 microbial taxa', but FR-003/FR-004 specify the model is trained on PCA scores, not taxa. Feature importances from the FR-004 model would be principal components, not taxa. Either the pipeline must map PC loadings back to taxa (no FR requires this) or the acceptance scenario contradicts the modeling requirements.

US-2's independent test mentions 'a confusion matrix (if classification)' while the spec unconditionally specifies a Random Forest regressor (FR-004, US-2 body). The classification branch is dead text and should be removed for terminological stability.
